title: The strict quotient tensor model and the normalized scalar-adjoint tower
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring, J an ideal, U a small pro-etale site object, R the completed coefficient sheaf on U, and M an object of D(R). Let P be a K-flat cochain complex of R-module sheaves [def-pc-kflat-complex] and eP:Q(P) isomorphic to M a specified isomorphism. The derived evaluation tower of the explicit complex of towers P tensor_R B_n[0] [def-sfb-adic-residue-quotient-tensor-tower] is isomorphic to the normalized scalar-adjoint tower G_n F_n M [lem-sfb-adic-residue-adjoint-tower]. Under this isomorphism the localized insertion-of-one map P to P tensor_R B_n[0] becomes eP followed by the nth scalar adjunction unit. No Koszul list, Noetherianity, cone assertion, or inverse limit occurs.

source.place: lemma-naive-completion (099M), strict coefficient tensor calculation; algebraization.tex, lemma-derived-completion-koszul (0A0E); more-algebra.tex, lemma-sequence-Koszul-complexes.

proof.text: Construct each comparison explicitly: localize scalarTensorComplexIso, apply resFactors, invert the universal scalar comparison using K-flatness, and map eP through extension and restriction. No isomorphism is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.
The one-successor identity supplies NatTrans.ofOpSequence. Apply NatIso.ofComponents to the already constructed level isomorphisms. This supplies naturality for all tower arrows.

The ordinary insertion identity, followed by the K-flat normalization of adicFiniteUnit, cancels the scalar-comparison isomorphism and its inverse. Naturality of adicFiniteUnit along eP identifies this with eP followed by the normalized scalar-adjunction unit. This proves the required equations for the assembled isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem adicResidue_quotient_tensor_model
    (M : AdicResidueLocalDerived.{u, v} X J U)
    (P : Cx ((completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U))
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (eP : (Q _).obj P ≅ M) :
    ∃ e : (adicResidueQuotientTensorComplex X J U P).asFunctor ⋙ Q _ ≅
        adicResidueAdjointTower.{u, v} X J U M,
      ∀ n : ℕ, (Q _).map (adicResidueQuotientTensorUnit X J U P n) ≫
        e.hom.app (op n) = eP.hom ≫
          (adicResidueScalarAdjunction.{u, v} X J U n).unit.app M
